title: Birds Arn't Real
tagline: Inside Job is a prediction market for past events, conspiracy theories,  and ancient technologies
description:
Inside is a  platform where users can bet on the truth behind controversial historical events—particularly those often dismissed as conspiracy theories. Instead of relying on traditional institutions, the platform empowers the public to fund and participate in truth-seeking by using prediction markets.

🎯 Core Concept
Users create markets around unresolved or disputed past events (e.g., “Was there a hidden city under the pyramids?”).
They can then decide what will resolve the market and vote on these resolution mechanisms with their LP share. 

The market opens when a resolution mechanism is selected. Users buy YES/NO shares, staking their beliefs.

The market prices reflect public belief over time. And resolves when the conspiracy is solved once and for all
how_its_made:
✨ Made with Privy, Solidity, React… and Vibes
This is a deeply experimental, highly expressive on-chain project built at the intersection of fringe curiosity and decentralized truth-seeking.

It’s made with:

Privy for user authentication and wallet abstraction,

Solidity for writing smart contracts that power the prediction markets,

React for the interactive front end, designed for immersion and exploration,

Deployed to Flow, pushing the boundaries of what alternative-history DApps can do on a performant, composable chain.
